== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Damascan]] soldiers are the military forces of the [[Damascan Kingdom]], often regarded as legendary figures who serve as the faceless extensions of their ruler's [[Authority|authority]]. The [[royal army]] is distinguished by its red-and-gold uniforms, whereas other soldiers may wear different colors, such as brown and purple. These troops are known for their disciplined organization, frequently moving in neat ranks or forming defensive circles with shields and spears. While some units utilize cavalry, many soldiers fight on foot. The military is capable of significant combat prowess, employing various weapons and tactics, including the use of [[steel]], short swords, and potentially summoned automatons or [[Golems|golems]]. They have been known to engage in pitched battles against other nations and fight alongside [[Travelers]] who can manipulate elements like lightning or open magical gates. Despite their reputation for being formidable and relentless, they have shown vulnerability when faced with powerful [[Incarnations]] or unexpected magical attacks, sometimes reacting with hesitation or attempting to flee. In certain instances, they have been seen managing captives or guarding city entrances.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|During the raid on [[Myria]], [[Damascan]] soldiers were responsible for the death of [[Ilana]]'s betrothed. In later conflicts, [[Simon]] killed several members of their ranks while [[Damascan]] troops engaged in combat with [[Nye]]. The soldiers eventually marched toward the Gate to meet [[Grandmaster Helgard]]. Following these events, members of the [[Damascan]] force were seen carrying [[Simon]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Simon]] has killed some [[Damascan soldiers]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
